summary: A celebration of the neo-cloud earnings: Nebius (NBIS, BUY) up 23% to $238 and CoreWeave (CRWV, BUY) up 17.7% on what he calls excellent quarters with strong forward commentary. Nebius posted 454% revenue growth to $582M, ARR up ~600% to $3B, 50% AI-cloud EBITDA margins, compressed deal payback to under two years, and per-megawatt pricing jumping from $12M to $20-25M with premium short-term tiers at $40-50M — leading him to speculate 2027 ARR could reach $20-25B vs much lower market expectations. CoreWeave grew revenue 112% to $2.57B with a $104.2B backlog (plus $25B signed early in Q3), cut its debt cost ~300bps saving ~$1.1B in annualized interest, and saw its first capacity auction clear 15% above prior Blackwell highs. On Nvidia (NVDA, BUY) — up 18.5% YTD despite being flat for much of the year — he highlights the $500B+ third-party AI compute financing platform with Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman, and KKR, which lowers the ecosystem's cost of capital and locks customers into CUDA; he argues Nvidia's broad-adoption model beats Google/Amazon's in-house ASICs. He also notes a potential October Anthropic IPO at a $1.5T target, warning it could bring SpaceX-style pre-IPO run-ups then volatility. His conclusion: there is no bubble signal here — growth and, for some, profitability are real.
title: Forget Nvidia. This Is the New King of AI
